title: The Boatyard Paint Cans
story: Three hulls sit on sawhorses at Okafor Boatyard, scraped bare and ready for a fresh coat. The paint cans, unfortunately, have lost their tags, and Felix will not open a can on a guess. "Shipshape or nothing," he says, reaching for the pencil behind his left ear. Which owner brought in which boat, and what color is going on it?

texts: Imani brought in neither the Sea Pea nor the Wavelet.
The owner who chose navy is neither Gus nor Imani.
The owner who chose navy brought in either the Lucky Gull or the Wavelet.
Imani chose either navy or sea green.

trace.text: Imani must go with the Lucky Gull: clue 1 rules out the Sea Pea and the Wavelet.
The navy paint must go with Basil: clue 2 rules out Gus and Imani.
Clue 3 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
The navy paint must go with the Wavelet: clue 3 rules out the Sea Pea; the Lucky Gull is already ruled out for Imani.
Basil must go with the Wavelet: the Sea Pea is already ruled out for the navy paint; the Lucky Gull already goes with Imani.
Gus must go with the Sea Pea: the other choices are already taken.
Clue 4 limits the choices (mark the X's it gives).
Imani must go with the sea green paint: clue 2 rules out the navy paint; clue 4 rules out the cream paint.
Gus must go with the cream paint: clue 2 rules out the navy paint; the sea green paint already goes with Imani.
The Lucky Gull goes with Imani, so the Lucky Gull also goes with the sea green paint.
The cream paint must go with the Sea Pea: the other choices are already taken.
